clusters.root_cause: Agent exhausts step budget when handling multiple sequential operations across different orders, failing to reach final summary or closing response. Multi-order requests (cancel+exchange across 2 orders, or return+modify across orders) require excessive get_order_details calls for disambiguation and sequential confirmation flows, consuming steps beyond threshold. The agent successfully executes all operations but terminates mid-calculation or mid-confirmation.
clusters.risk: High - Complex multi-order tasks consistently fail when operations span 2+ orders; single-order multi-item exchanges succeed. The 10% stuck_rate and p95_steps at 41 confirm structural inefficiency in multi-order traversal.
